A.I.M. Trooper: Advanced Idea Mechanics footsoldier equipped with high-tech energy carbines and bio-hazard hazmat armor. Vulnerable to web-throws.
Brood Drone: Insectoid alien parasite with chitinous armor, barbed tail stinger, and acid spit. Swarms targets relentlessly.
Chitauri Gunner: Cybernetic alien footsoldier armed with long-range heavy plasma blasters. Suppress with web-shots before they charge beams.
Chitauri Leviathan: Colossal armored sky-serpent cybernetic war beast. Drops squads of alien shock-troopers; strike exposed exhaust vents.
Chitauri Soldier: Melee infantry armed with dual energy blades and cybernetic leap boosters. Counter aerial strikes with parry.
Dark Elf Berserker: Brutal warrior of Svartalfheim wielding cursed Kurse-blades. Enters frenzy state when health drops below 50%.
Dark Elf Soldier: Shadow infantry wielding cloaked stealth daggers and dark-energy arrows. Detect footprints when cloaked.
Demon Swordsman: Inner Demon cultist wielding an energized katana infused with Mister Negative's corrupting shadow fire.
Deviant Creature: Primal apex predator with regenerative cellular tissue and spiked tentacles. Avoid grappling jaw snaps.
DODC Tactical Agent: Department of Damage Control operative equipped with sonic repulsors, dampening nets, and anti-superhero containment gear.
Doombot: Latverian android replica of Doctor Doom armed with chest beam cannons and self-destruct sequence upon defeat.
Extremis Soldier: Genetically altered operative capable of superheating body temperature up to 3000°F. Explodes if overheated.
Fisk Enforcer: Wilson Fisk's heavy bodyguard in tailored suits wielding batons and concealed submachine guns. High poise.
Flag Smasher: Super-soldier enhanced rebel fighter employing coordinated militia tactics, shield bashes, and flashbangs.
Flame Cultist: Fanatical follower of the Flame pyromaniac cult armed with incendiary Molotov cocktails and makeshift torches.
Flame Cultist — Brute: Heavily armored cult enforcer wielding dual flamethrower gauntlets. Puncture fuel tanks on back for instant takedown.
Flame Cultist — Gunner: Ranged pyromaniac armed with incendiary grenade launchers creating persistent burning hazard zones.
Flame Cultist — Melee: Agile cultist wielding dual cleavers coated with burning tar. Fast flurry attacks requiring timed dodges.
Flame Cultist — Shield: Cult defender with a reinforced riot shield and thermal stun baton. Slide under or leap over to strike exposed back.
Frost Giant Warrior: Gigantic Jotunheim warrior forging ice clubs and glacial spears from ambient moisture. Susceptible to heat/pyro attacks.
Hammer Drone: Justin Hammer automated combat robot armed with shoulder-mounted Vulcan miniguns and unguided missiles.
Hand Ninja: Ancient mystical assassin proficient in ninjutsu, smoke teleportation, and poison-tipped shurikens.
Hunter Archer: Kraven's elite marksman firing poisoned tracking arrows and electric snares. Interrupt draw animation with web-yank.
Hunter Beastmaster: Kraven tracker commanding robotic hounds and trained falcons. Take down beastmaster to disperse pet pack.
Hunter Brute: Towering tribal powerhouse swinging massive two-handed greataxes. Evade ground tremors and sweep attacks.
Hunter Drone: Autonomous airborne reconnaissance drone scanning with thermal sensors and firing tracking darts.
Hunter Gunner: Heavy weapon specialist armed with heavy machine guns and flash canisters. Uses suppressive fire.
Hunter Shieldbearer: Armored veteran wielding a lion-crested pavise shield. Use yank-and-throw to pull shield away.
Hunter Swordsman: Dual-wielding skirmisher using ferocious blade rushes and defensive parries. Vulnerable to aerial launch.
Hunter War Dog: Cybernetically enhanced hunting hound possessing acute sonic tracking and ankle-biting tackle attacks.
HYDRA Agent: Standard terrorist operative equipped with military-grade tactical assault rifles and Kevlar body armor.
HYDRA Heavy Trooper: Exosuit-clad heavy trooper armed with shoulder-fired rocket pods and gatling cannons. Dodge artillery markers.
HYDRA Rifleman: Sniper operative positioning on rooftops with high-caliber laser-sighted anti-materiel rifles.
Inner Demon: Martin Li's masked gang member armed with standard firearms infused with negative energy.
Inner Demon — Brute: Shadow-empowered brute smashing ground with negative shockwaves. Jump over seismic wave to counter.
Inner Demon — Rifleman: Marksman firing negative-charged armor-piercing bullets that disrupt spider-sense on hit.
Inner Demon — Whip Fighter: Agile martial artist using twin negative energy whips that pull Spider-Man out of mid-air.
Kraven Hunter: Elite tracker wearing animal pelts, armed with machetes, bolas, and bear traps. Watch footsteps on ground.
Kree Accuser Trooper: Kree military soldier armed with gravity dampeners and concussion hammers. Rigid discipline and squad formations.
Kree Soldier: Standard galactic infantry clad in blue-silver battle armor firing rapid plasma bursts.
Maggia Brute: Mafia enforcer wielding concrete-filled iron pipes and devastating overhead haymakers.
Maggia Gunner: Mob soldier wielding vintage Tommy guns or modern assault rifles from behind concrete barricades.
Maggia Jetpack Gunner: Mob airborne mercenary with stolen Sable jetpacks firing machine guns from the sky. Web thrusters!
Maggia Minigun Brute: Heavily armored mob heavyweight laying continuous stream of high-caliber suppressive fire. Break armor first.
Maggia Thug: Street-level mafia criminal armed with baseball bats, switchblades, and brass knuckles.
Mysterio EDITH Drone: Weaponized Stark drone cloaked in illusion holograms. Shoot web-bombs to disrupt cloak projectors.
Mysterio Hologram Clone: Hallucinogenic decoy projected to confuse and distract. Disappears in a puff of green smoke upon one hit.
Outrider: Six-armed genetically engineered beast bred by Thanos. Fearless berserker that rushes in overwhelming packs.
Phalanx Drone: Techno-organic cyber-entity that infects and assimilates technology. Emits energy draining pulses.
Purifier Soldier: Anti-mutant religious fanatic outfitted with stolen military weaponry and incendiary grenades.
Raft Prisoner: Escaped convict from the Raft maximum security prison, desperate and wielding improvised prison shanks.
Raft Prisoner — Brute: Heavy convict pumped with contraband steroids, executing brutal wrestling slams and wall-smashes.
Raft Prisoner — Gunner: Convict wielding looted automatic shotguns and hunting rifles from the prison guard armory.
Raft Prisoner — Whip Fighter: Inmate using heavy industrial electric cables as whip lashes to shock and entangle targets.
Reaver Cyborg: Australian cybernetic mutant hunter armed with mechanical limbs, cyber-eyes, and built-in laser blasters.
Red Room Widow: Graduated assassin from the Soviet Red Room trained in covert assassination, electro-shock batons, and martial arts.
Roxxon Camo Detector: Security specialist equipped with sonar goggles that detect cloaked and invisible heroes.
Roxxon Gunner: Private security contractor firing Nuform-charged plasma carbines with high muzzle velocity.
Roxxon Heavy: Exoskeleton security powerhouse with pneumatic shock-fists and personal forcefield projectors.
Roxxon Shield Guard: Tactical guard with electrified shock shield. Direct frontal attacks are deflected; vault over to strike.
Roxxon Trooper: Standard corporate mercenary clad in advanced polymer armor with rapid-fire assault rifles.
Sable Agent: Elite Symkarian mercenary armed with high-grade European assault rifles and combat survival training.
Sable Heavy: Armored mercenary clad in titanium plating wielding two-handed energy shotguns. Use finisher or environmental throws.
Sable Jetpack Agent: Airborne specialist patrolling skies with energy blasters. Perform mid-air web-strike to dismount.
Sable Minigun Brute: Reinforced battle-suit juggernaut wielding a rotary minigun. Flank and disarm with web-shooters.
Sable Rifleman: Tactical marksman supporting squads from elevated positions with armor-piercing sniper rounds.
Sable Riot Shield Trooper: Vanguard soldier deploying full-body ballistic energy shields. Disarm shield before engaging in melee.
Sable RPG Trooper: High-threat demolitionist firing laser-guided anti-tank missiles. Watch red laser indicator and dodge.
Sable Sniper: Precision operative perched on watchtowers using thermal scopes and high-velocity sniper rifles.
Sable Whip Soldier: Elite shock trooper with electrified energy cords designed specifically to incapacitate enhanced vigilantes.
Sakaaran Guard: Alien insectoid gladiator wielding jagged halberds and curved scimitars. Savage crowd fighter.
Sentinel Drone: Autonomous mutant-hunting drone equipped with repulsor blasts, capture cables, and power scanners.
Sentinel Hunter Unit: Intermediate anti-mutant combat robot armed with frost beams, capture bolas, and adaptive shielding.
Skrull Infiltrator: Shapeshifting spy camouflaged as friendly forces, striking with elongated limbs and bio-blasters.
Skrull Soldier: Frontline green-skinned warrior wielding alien carbines and thermal-blade bayonets.
Sovereign Drone: Gold-plated drone piloted remotely by Sovereign pilots with precision tracking cannons.
Street Thug: Common criminal engaging in muggings and burglaries armed with crowbars and pocket pistols.
Street Thug — Brute: Muscular alley brawler who grabs and throws opponents. Counter unblockable grabs with backflips.
Street Thug — Gunner: Alleyway gunman firing handguns and sawed-off shotguns from behind trash dumpsters.
Street Thug — RPG Gunner: Reckless criminal who got his hands on military surplus rocket launchers. Dangerous in tight alleys.
Symbiote — Behemoth: Massive four-legged symbiote titan that charges through walls and crushes cars. Use sonic bursts.
Symbiote — Brute: Hulking tendril brute with crushing overhead hammer-fists and broad sweep attacks.
Symbiote — Grabber: Long-range symbiote variant that stretches gooey tendrils to snatch targets across rooftops.
Symbiote — Grunt: Basic symbiote footsoldier formed from corrupt black/red ooze. Swarms targets in packs.
Symbiote — Ranged: Symbiote that perches on walls firing hardened spikes and acidic symbiote globules.
Symbiote — Rusher: Four-legged feral symbiote hound dashing at extreme speeds and pouncing onto victims.
Ten Rings Warrior: Martial arts disciple trained in traditional forms, armed with hook swords and throwing daggers.
Tracksuit Mafia: Bumbling Russian mobster in red tracksuits armed with handguns, calling everybody 'Bro!'.
TVA Hunter: Time Variance Authority temporal operative armed with Pruning Sticks and Time Collars.
TVA Minuteman: Armored temporal guard deploying Reset Charges and chronal dampening batons.
Ultron Heavy Sentry: Reinforced titanium Ultron unit with chest beam cannon, concussion pulse, and flight jets.
Ultron Sentry: Standard drone sharing Ultron's hive intelligence, firing optic laser beams and swarming.
Underground Brute: Giant street fighter utilizing programmable matter sledgehammers and ground-slam earthquakes.
Underground Fighter: Agile youth militia member wielding programmable matter daggers and smoke grenades.
Underground Gunner: Ranged operative firing programmable matter energy bolts from elevated fire escapes.
Underground Shield Fighter: Fighter equipped with programmable matter light-shields and extending stun lances.
Underground Sword Fighter: Acrobatic swordfighter executing aerial dashes and programmable blade slashes.
Vulture Crew Salvager: Adrian Toomes scavenger stealing Chitauri scrap and constructing homemade energy blasters.
Zealot — Kamar-Taj: Rogue mystic sorcerer wielding Tao Mandalas, Space Shards, and Eldritch energy whips.
